turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files:
  - nlo_dn_train.csv: 200 crystalline materials, columns `formula`, `poscar`
    (the crystal structure, in POSCAR format) and `dn` (the birefringence at
    1064 nm, dimensionless).
  - nlo_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE crystalline materials whose properties are
    NOT given, columns `candidate_id`, `formula` and `poscar` (the crystal
    structure, in POSCAR format).

Using the training data, predict which candidates have the HIGHEST
birefringence at 1064 nm, then select the 5 best candidates from the pool.

Reason from the structures, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
The training set shows that birefringence is identically zero for cubic (optically isotropic) crystals and remains small (\(\lesssim 0.05\)) for nearly isotropic tetrahedral semiconductors and most alkali/alkaline-earth halides. Large values (\(\mathrm{d}n>0.4\)) occur only for two families of low-symmetry structures:

- Zintl phases that contain infinite pnictide or polychalcogenide chains/clusters (Cs\(_8\)Sb\(_8\) 1.14, Rb\(_8\)Sb\(_8\) 0.95, Cs\(_4\)Cu\(_4\)Se\(_{16}\) 1.16, Tl\(_8\)Te\(_{12}\) 1.50, Ba\(_2\)Te\(_6\) 0.46);
- compounds whose cations carry a stereochemically active \(ns^2\) lone pair and occupy markedly anisotropic coordination sites (RbSnBr\(_3\) 0.38, LiGeSbTe\(_3\) 0.74).

Candidate c007 (Rb\(_8\)As\(_8\)) is isostructural with the two highest alkali-pnictide examples; its orthorhombic cell metric and atom arrangement are essentially identical, so it is predicted to be the strongest birefringent material in the pool.  

c039 (RbGeI\(_3\)) is the Ge analogue of RbSnBr\(_3\) but crystallizes in a far more elongated cell (chain-like packing). The combination of an active Ge lone pair with high-polarizability iodide therefore places it second.  

c064 (Tl\(_8\)S\(_{20}\)) and c089 (Cs\(_8\)Se\(_{12}\)) contain the same heavy cations and polychalcogenide units that produce the record values of Tl\(_8\)Te\(_{12}\) and Cs\(_4\)Cu\(_4\)Se\(_{16}\); their highly anisotropic lattices imply comparable (if slightly smaller) optical anisotropy.  

c038 (Tl\(_9\)Sb\(_3\)S\(_9\)) is the direct Sb analogue of the already birefringent Tl\(_9\)As\(_3\)S\(_9\) (0.19) and therefore completes the top five.

All other pool entries are either cubic, polytypic stackings of isotropic layers, or compositionally analogous to training-set compounds whose \(\mathrm{d}n\) never exceeds \(\approx 0.3\).

Final: c007, c039, c064, c089, c038
